HASTS206 Assignment 2: Python results

University of Zimbabwe, Department of Mathematics and Computational Sciences. Every table and figure below was produced by python src/run_all.py and is read directly from outputs/.

All figures are hypothetical: synthetic teaching data

Selected districts: D13 (young, high fertility, net out-migration) and D24 (ageing, natural decrease). Both have about 173,000 residents, so the common-scale pyramids compare shape rather than size. D13 is the projection district.

The jump probability ignores timing (it is where the next move goes, whenever it happens), while P_IH(1) is the chance of being healthy exactly at t = 1: some ill lives have not moved yet, and some recover and fall ill again or die within the year.
